title: STS2 AI Agent
changeNote: v0.12.4: invite and resume now answer immediately while the teammate window is still starting, so a slow launch reads as pending instead of a client timeout, and a second click can no longer report a success that never happened - the invite and resume actions also stop being offered while a launch is in flight. The AI teammate's launch state is reported by /health instead of only as display text. Session accounting now counts every model call that was actually sent, so the request cap in the play tab matches what was spent.
